scenario.goal_zh: 核对供电要求和功能后选定适合房间的型号

context_zh: 顾客通过铭牌和产品说明比较两款电暖器。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Do these heaters consume the same amount of electricity?

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: At full power, this one draws one kilowatt and that one draws two. Both run from a standard wall socket.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: My study is tiny. Would the smaller one be effective there?

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: Its label says it is designed for rooms of that size. It also has a timer.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: It takes longer to warm a larger room, but you said you only need it for the study.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: That is right. I will take the smaller model with the timer.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: Here is the manual. It includes the clearance distances you need to check before using it.
